definitions.explanation: A device that projects images or film onto a screen. Traditionally refers to a film projector, but also used for modern digital projectors.

examples.japanese: {映写機|えいしゃき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{映写機|えいしゃき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦フィルム→フィルム：02951_firumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上映|じょうえい}→上映：08380_jouei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We screened a film using an old projector.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{映写機|えいしゃき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{故障|こしょう}して→故障する：01826_koshousuru⟧、⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せられなかった→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: The classroom projector was broken, so we couldn't show the video in class.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{映写|えいしゃ}→映写：22463_eisha⟧ (projection) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine). Traditionally referred to film projectors that used celluloid reels, but now also covers digital projectors. In modern everyday conversation, プロジェクター (the loanword) is more common for digital projectors, while {映写機|えいしゃき} retains a more classic or formal feel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {映写機|えいしゃき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to run the projector (film-era usage)
- {映写機|えいしゃき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧: the light of the projector
- {映写機|えいしゃき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{操作|そうさ}する→操作する：18999_sousasuru⟧: to operate the projector

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プロジェクター: projector — the modern loanword, standard for digital devices
- {幻灯機|げんとうき}: magic lantern; slide projector — an older type of image projector
- ⟦{映写|えいしゃ}→映写：22463_eisha⟧: projection — the act itself, without the machine
